ai_summary: Amber Enterprises' material subsidiary, IL JIN, is acquiring the remaining 40% equity in Power-One Micro Systems via a share swap, making Power-One a wholly-owned subsidiary and consolidating a growing business in solar, EV, and power solutions. This strategic move, valued through the issuance of Compulsorily Convertible Preference Shares, streamlines the group structure and secures full control over a key asset. Although the transaction involves related parties, Amber states it is conducted on an arm's length basis, mitigating a potential red flag.
